title: The rift expands
next_chapter_hook: The Settlement Envoy's voice thundered across the sky above the Imperial Capital: 'Chen Ji, you are merely a designed key! Surrender the turtle shell or perish with the three realms!'

text.content: That fork in the road that had never appeared in any prophecy was now tearing through reality at a visible speed. The rift above the Imperial Capital, originally only three chi wide, violently expanded the moment Chen Ji and Su Qingyao's bloodlines resonated, like a startled giant opening its gaping maw. The rift's edges radiated an eerie violet-black glow—dimensional erosion's mark, an otherworldly aura even Heavenly Secrets couldn't fully shield.

dialogue.content: Something's wrong... the expansion speed is off!

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, eyes wide open. His Tianji Record was trembling violently, displaying a terrifying string of numbers—less than two hours remained before dimensional invasion completely consumed all three realms. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul on the first page flickered intensely, its blurred face etched with unprecedented anxiety.

dialogue.content: Master, dire news! The old Heavenly Secrets Guardians have launched a full-scale assault! They're taking advantage of the dimensional rifts dividing the three realms' attention, striking the Imperial Capital from the outside!

text.content: Before the words even finished, earth-shaking battle cries rang out from the Imperial Capital's eastern region. Ye Qing's Xuanwu Guard was locked in fierce combat with an unfamiliar force—those cultivators wore golden eye pupil insignias, the mark of the old Heavenly Secrets Guardians. Through the Tianji Record's shared vision, Chen Ji saw the Settlement Envoy's figure already appearing in the sky above the Imperial Capital's outskirts, surrounded by black mist far denser than any Heavenly Secrets Will projection.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji! The southwestern rift suddenly expanded tenfold! Something's coming through!

text.content: Ye Qing's transmission carried unprecedented panic. Chen Ji turned to look, only to see the southwestern sky had been completely torn apart, a rift large enough to allow a half-giant's body to probe through was ravenously devouring everything around it. That oppressive aura was impossible to直视 even for cultivators at the Heavenly Fate realm, as if something transcending cognition was attempting to cross the dimensional barrier. The citizens within the Imperial Capital began screaming hysterically, their wails blending with the thunderous collapse of buildings into a prelude of apocalypse.

Simultaneously, emergency reports from across the three realms arrived like snowflakes—Xuanwu Sect's mountain gate trembled, its protective mountain formation developed cracks; the Demonic Path's territory was shrouded in pervasive black mist, countless demon cultivators corrupted by otherworldly aura transforming into malformed monsters; even the distant Eastern Sea Cultivator Alliance reported诡异的 cracks appearing along the coastline, seawater flowing backward into the Void. The order of the three realms completely shattered at this moment, and the source of it all—that initial rift opened by Chen Ji—was expanding at a geometric rate.

dialogue.content: Foolish chess piece... you thought the fractured Heavenly Secrets was an asset, never knowing this was precisely the moment this One awaited. Whether dimensional invasion or the old Heavenly Secrets' counterattack, they are all moves on this One's chessboard. And you, Chen Ji, from start to finish have been nothing but a designed key!

text.content: The Heavenly Secrets Eye's voice rang directly within Chen Ji's Mental Sea, its tone cold and delighted, as if observing prey that had finally walked into a trap. Chen Ji tightly clenched his fists, fingernails digging deep into his palms, blood dripping through his fingers. He felt an unprecedented fury burning in his chest, but more than that was a bone-deep chill—he had schemed for years, believing himself meticulous in all calculations, yet he had never realized he had been on someone else's chessboard from the very beginning.

But the anger lasted only three breaths. Chen Ji took a deep breath, his originally blood-red eyes gradually recovering their usual calm depth. He surveyed the chaotic scene before him—the southwestern dimensional rift devouring everything, the Settlement Envoy eyeing from the north with sinister intent, rifts across all territories spinning out of control—yet a cold smile slowly formed at the corner of his mouth. He made a mental note, committing this debt to memory. But now was not the time for settling accounts; first, he had to survive the day.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng, can the turtle shell artifact seal the rift's core?

It can... but the cost is pouring all your Heavenly Fate into it. With your remaining Heavenly Fate, after sealing... you will completely lose the Tianji Record's protection, becoming a true ordinary person.

choice.prompt: The Imperial Capital teetered on the brink of destruction. Chen Ji had to make a choice. His Heavenly Fate was nearly depleted; once completely consumed, he would lose all ability to foresee the future, becoming reduced to waste that could be casually crushed by others. But if the rift wasn't sealed, the three realms would completely fall within two hours. What choice should he make?

dialogue.content: The three realms can exist without Chen Ji, but they cannot be without tomorrow!

choices.text: Sacrifice the part to preserve the whole

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze was cold as iron, his voice spreading across the entire Imperial Capital through the sound transmission array: "All cultivators in non-core areas, withdraw immediately! This is an order!"

Just as Chen Ji was weighing the pros and cons, the battle situation at the Imperial Capital's periphery suddenly changed. Though the Xuanwu Guards led by Ye Qing were well-trained, facing the wheel-warfare tactics of the Old Heavenly Way Guardians Alliance, they gradually showed signs of exhaustion. Worse still, Qingsuan Shi personally intervened—with a single slash of the sword in his hand, wrapped in golden chains, over thirty Xuanwu Guards were instantly reduced to ashes, not even having time to scream.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji! I can't hold on much longer! That madman has no honor, just venting his rage on the small soldiers!

text.content: Ye Qing's voice transmission carried suppressed fury. She was the Holy Maiden of the Demonic Path, having commanded battlefields for years, never once having been so disregarded. Yet this Qingsuan Shi simply didn't play by the rules, completely ignoring her challenges, focused only on slaughtering ordinary cultivators. This approach rendered her Demonic Path Mists completely useless—the opponent didn't care at all about being outmaneuvered, only about the killing itself.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's battle situation was critical, she was barely managing to delay Qingsuan Shi's slaughter with her Demonic Path Mists. But if Chen Ji goes to support her now, the rift will have no one to guard it, and the expansion rate will further accelerate. He must make a choice—trust that Ye Qing can hold on, or personally confront that mad Qingsuan Shi?

choices.description: Ignore the rift, personally go to the periphery to kill Qingsuan Shi, showing loyalty to one's own.

text.content: Chen Ji's voice rang in Ye Qing's mind, carrying a reassuring calm: "Move three steps left. The Demonic Path mist covers the northwest direction—he's making a feint elsewhere while attacking here."

choices.text: Order Ye Qing to strategically retreat

dialogue.content: Ye Qing, this is no time for petty emotions. Strategic retreat, preserve our strength—this is an order.

text.content: At that moment, the giant rift above the imperial capital underwent another transformation. A massive hand covered in scales slowly extended from the fissure, its size large enough to shade half the imperial city. Each scale pulsed with suffocating dimensional power. Cultivators below the Heavenly Fate realm felt their souls tearing apart merely by glimpsing that hand, their agonized screams echoing continuously.

Chen Ji rapidly deduced various possibilities through the Tianji Record—that massive hand's appearance signaled the dimensional invasion had escalated from fissure seepage to physical descent. If they didn't force it back before fully crossing over, the entire imperial capital would be crushed to dust beneath its pressure. Yet he found himself in an unprecedented predicament: on one side was the destabilizing dimensional rift, on the other the arrogant Settlement Envoy, his forces too stretched to handle both.

dialogue.content: Do you see it, Chen Ji? This is the consequence of betraying this One. You believed the fractured Heavenly Dao was your ally, unaware this was precisely the opportunity this One awaited. Dimensional invasion or the old Heavenly Dao's backlash—both are merely moves on this One's chessboard. And you? You are merely a pre-designed key!

text.content: The Heavenly Secrets Eye's voice reverberated through Chen Ji's Mental Sea, cold and delighted, as if observing prey finally entering the trap. Chen Ji clenched his fists tightly, fingernails embedding deep into his palms, blood dripping between his fingers. He felt an unprecedented fury burning in his chest, but more than that—a bone-deep chill. He had schemed for years, believing himself infallible, yet had never realized he was all along a piece on another's chessboard without even knowing it.

But the rage lasted only three breaths. Chen Ji drew a deep breath, those eyes blood-red from fury gradually returning to their usual composed depth. He surveyed the chaotic situation before him—the southwestern dimensional rift devouring everything, the Settlement Envoy eyeing them covetously from the north, that massive hand about to fully descend—yet his lips slowly curved into a cold smile. He made a mental note, he would settle this score. But now was not the time for settling accounts, survival first.

Just then, Su Qingyao's voice came from behind, carrying unprecedented gravity: "Chen Ji, I sense it... that massive hand's pressure is resonating with the Settlement Envoy. They are working together! This is a premeditated alliance!" Chen Ji spun around, the Qingyao Sword in Su Qingyao's hands trembling violently, its engravings' resonance with the Tianji Record growing ever stronger—that was the fourth possibility's guidance, a path he had never witnessed.

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao discovered the crucial truth—the dimensional invasion and the old Heavenly Dao's backlash were acting in concert! That massive hand shared some mysterious resonance with the Settlement Envoy, meaning Chen Ji could no longer treat them as separate threats. He had to make the final strategic choice: exploit this resonance to turn them against each other, or strike with full force to shatter this conspiracy?

choices.text: Join forces with Su Qingyao for a strike

text.content: Chen Ji took the initiative to收敛 his aura, pretending to be震慑 by the威压. His body trembled slightly, as if unable to bear the burden—but only Su Qingyao could feel that his hand holding hers remained steady and powerful.

No matter what choice Chen Ji makes, the situation is developing in an uncontrollable direction. The expansion speed of the dimensional rift far exceeds expectations, and that giant hand has fully emerged, trying to tear its entire body free from the rift. At the same time, the Liquidator has stopped killing. He hovers in mid-air, those golden eyes死死盯着 Chen Ji, a cruel smile curling his lips.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, you are merely a designed key! Surrender the Turtle Shell or perish with the Three Realms!

text.content: The Liquidator's voice exploded like thunder across the皇都 sky, his威压 making the air within a hundred li freeze solid. The cultivators of the Old Heavenly Dao Guardian Alliance behind him shouted in unison, waves of sound crashing one after another, as if they would shatter the entire皇都. The Xuanwu Guard's formation was already tottering; Ye Qing's face was pale as paper, yet she still死死 blocked the front, demonic path mist swirling around her, reflecting that倔强的 face.

Chen Ji stood at the highest point of the皇都, overlooking this land about to become a battlefield. Behind him were shivering commoners, a crumbling护城大阵; before him was the apocalyptic threat of dimensional invasion, the arrogant aggression of the Old Heavenly Dao's counterattack. Mo Xiansheng's残魂剧烈波动ed within the Tianji Record, that苍老 face filled with worry—he knew Chen Ji was facing an unprecedented choice, a choice that would determine the fate of the Three Realms.

However, at this critical moment, Chen Ji actually smiled. That smile was ice-cold and mocking, as if watching a跳梁小丑. His right hand slowly rose, the Turtle Shell Divine Artifact blooming dazzling golden light in his palm, interweaving with the silver glow of the Tianji Record. His voice was not loud, yet it clearly entered every person's ear present—including that giant hand about to fully跨界, the hovering Liquidator in the sky, and the Heavenly Dao's Eye that had been watching coldly in his识海.

dialogue.content: Surrender the Turtle Shell? Heh... Do you really think I reached today relying on this broken key?

text.content: Before the words even finished, Chen Ji's figure suddenly vanished from its location. The next second, he appeared above that giant hand, the Turtle Shell Divine Artifact slammed狠狠 onto the scales of that giant hand! Golden and purple-black light collided violently, erupting with a shockwave sufficient to tear apart the sky. At the same moment, Su Qingyao's Qingyao Sword stabbed from another direction, forming a perfect pincer attack with Chen Ji—the true meaning of the fourth possibility, the破局之道 never appearing in any prophecy!

The dimensional rift trembled violently under the combined attack of Chen Ji and Su Qingyao. That giant hand let out aearth-shaking roar, purple-black blood spurting from the gaps between scales. The Liquidator's expression changed abruptly; he hadn't expected Chen Ji to dare take the initiative, nor had he expected Su Qingyao to form such tacit cooperation with him. He wanted to intervene, but it was already too late—the resonance power of the Tianji Record and Qingyao Sword was tearing apart the barrier between dimensions and the Three Realms, and that giant hand was precisely the key maintaining this passage!

With a thunderous rumble, that giant hand was severed by force. The enormous body疯狂挣扎ed in the dimensional rift, ultimately tumbling back to the other side of the rift. Purple-black blood poured down like a waterfall, dyeing the outskirts of the皇都 into a eerie purple sea. The Liquidator's offensive halted abruptly; all his arrogance transformed into shock and fury—he never imagined that his meticulously planned scheme would be so cleanly destroyed by a "废物".

But Chen Ji did not stop there. His gaze passed beyond that hand retreating into the rift, beyond the shocked Liquidator, fixing directly on that faintly visible Heavenly Dao Will projection above the Nine Heavens. A cold smirk curled his lips, a smile containing too many complex emotions—anger, mockery, and a hint of barely perceptible madness. He knew the Heavenly Dao's Eye was watching, knew every one of his movements was being recorded, and he was determined to tear apart the opponent's meticulously designed chess game before all these eyes.

dialogue.content: You want to watch a show? Then let you watch your fill!

text.content: Chen Ji猛然催动 all the remaining power in his body. The pages of the Tianji Record疯狂翻动ed, golden runes pouring out from within him, producing an unprecedented resonance with the Turtle Shell Divine Artifact. That resonance's shockwave swept in all directions, not only repelling the蠢蠢欲动的 Liquidator, but also causing the dimensional rift above the皇都 to briefly stabilize. Although only temporary, it bought precious respite for the Three Realms. Ye Qing took the opportunity to reorganize the Xuanwu Guard formation; Su Qingyao's sword intent echoed with Chen Ji from afar. Though wordless, the two had achieved unspoken tacit understanding.

The Liquidator's expression was gloomy enough to drip water. He stared at Chen Ji, his killing intent almost solidifying into实质. This废物, this ant that should have been crushed to death, actually dared to destroy his multi-year plan right before his face! He took a deep breath, forcefully suppressing the fury in his heart, and阴恻恻地 spoke: "Good, very good... Chen Ji, this matter, this seat remembers. You think severing one dimensional hand can change anything?不过是延缓死亡罢了!" With that, his figure slowly retreated, disappearing into the formation of the Old Heavenly Dao Guardian Alliance.

But just as the Liquidator vanished, the Heavenly Dao's Eye's voice rang out once more in Chen Ji's识海. This time, that voice carried a hint of barely perceptible appreciation: "Interesting... This seat indeed did not misjudge you. But Chen Ji, you think this is the破局? You are wrong. This is merely letting the chess piece live a bit longer. Dimensional invasion is merely an appetizer; the Old Heavenly Dao's counterattack is merely an前菜. The real正餐... is still to come." As the voice fell, that Heavenly Dao Will projection above the Nine Heavens slowly dissipated, yet Chen Ji felt an unprecedented chill spread from his spine throughout his entire body.

Chen Ji slowly landed, his legs slightly weak. That strike had almost exhausted all his strength, and the Turtle Shell Divine Artifact had also developed fine cracks from overloading. But there was not a trace of exhaustion on his face; instead, a meaningful smile spread across his features. He raised his head to gaze at the sky, as if facing that already dissipated Heavenly Dao Will. Mo Xiansheng's残魂 sighed gently in his识海, that苍老 face filled with complex emotions—gratification, worry, and an indefinable expectation.

dialogue.content: 正餐? Heh, I'd like to see what dishes you can still serve.

text.content: Su Qingyao walked quickly to Chen Ji's side, reaching out to support his摇摇欲坠 body. Her brows were tightly furrowed, eyes full of worry: "You were too reckless just now... If that strike had gone wrong, both of us would have died without a place for burial." Chen Ji glanced at her, a faint smile curling his lips: "Didn't it not go wrong?" Su Qingyao was噎了一下, about to retort, when she saw Chen Ji's expression suddenly become solemn. He gazed at the outskirts of the皇都, at that land dyed red by purple-black blood, and said softly: "The real trouble... has just begun."

Ye Qing also walked over at this moment. Exhaustion from battle still lingered on her face, but those eyes were blazing. She looked at Chen Ji, a playful smile curling her lips: "That sword just now was very dashing. However..." She paused, her gaze sweeping over Chen Ji's pale face, "Are you pushing yourself too hard? Don't forget, you promised to help me uncover the truth behind the Holy Sect. If you die, who will fulfill this promise?" Chen Ji heard this and轻笑一声, about to speak, when he suddenly felt the Tianji Record tremble violently once more—a new crisis, quietly brewing in the shadows.

The Tianji Record turned to a new page, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul face appeared once more, and this time, the aged visage was filled with unprecedented solemnity. His voice emerged low and grave: 'Master, your actions just now, though temporarily stabilizing the rift, have also exposed the true source of the Tianji Record's power. The Eye of Heavenly Dao has sensed the existence of the Fourth Possibility... From now on, it will hunt you with even greater ferocity. And that existence that has been watching from the shadows... is probably about to make its move.' Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly, about to press for more, when he sensed a familiar yet strange aura emanating from the edge of the heavens—that was Chen Nian's aura, the aura of his sister who had been missing for years!

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He abruptly looked up toward the heavens, only to see nothingness. Chen Nian's aura flashed and vanished, so swift it seemed like an illusion. But Chen Ji knew it wasn't an illusion—it was real, Chen Nian was calling him for help! His hands unconsciously clenched tight, fingernails digging into his palms once more. Mo Xiansheng seemed to sense his abnormality, sighing and saying: 'Master, she is sealed within the core region of Heavenly Dao's will. No foresight ability can peer into the truth there. But if you wish to save her, you must become stronger... strong enough that even Heavenly Dao cannot ignore.'

Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the anxiety that threatened to shatter his rationality. His gaze turned deep and calm once more, as if that moment of loss of composure had never happened. Both Ye Qing and Su Qingyao sensed his abnormality, but neither spoke up to inquire. They knew everyone has forbidden zones in their hearts that cannot be touched. Ye Qing broke the silence first, gazing at the gradually stabilizing rift and softly saying: 'Regardless, we've won this battle today. What now?' Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then slowly spoke: 'First, clean up the battlefield and安置伤员. Though the rift is temporarily stable, the erosion from the purple-black blood is still spreading and must be dealt with urgently.'

Su Qingyao nodded, about to turn and leave, when she suddenly stopped. She looked back at Chen Ji, a complex light flickering in her eyes: 'That sword strike just now... I could sense some kind of resonance forming between the Qingyao Sword and the Tianji Record. That is the direction of the Fourth Possibility, isn't it?' Chen Ji did not speak, only nodding slightly. A faint smile curved Su Qingyao's lips, a smile containing far too many emotions she had never voiced: 'Next time, if there are such risky ventures, remember to inform me in advance. I don't want... to see you bearing everything alone again.' With that, she turned and rode her sword away, leaving only a cold and resolute silhouette.

Ye Qing gazed at Su Qingyao's departing figure, then looked at Chen Ji, a meaningful smile curling her lips: 'It seems our great strategist Chen is quite popular with the ladies.' Chen Ji shot her an exasperated glance: 'Don't talk nonsense, this isn't the time for that.' Ye Qing shrugged, rarely refraining from further teasing. She gazed into the distance, a trace of worry flickering in her eyes: 'That Liquidation Emissary... won't let this matter rest. Though we won a battle today, his foundations still lie with the Old Heavenly Dao Guardians Alliance. When he comes again, it won't be so easy to handle.'

Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then slowly nodded: 'I know. But what worries me most right now isn't him, it's...' His gaze once again turned to the heavens, to the direction where Chen Nian's aura had vanished. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul seemed to sense his thoughts, softly speaking in his Mental Sea: 'Master, Chen Nian小姐's aura suddenly appearing here is by no means coincidence. This means the Eye of Heavenly Dao is using her to test your reactions... It is forcing you to make a choice.' A cold light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes, his voice icy enough to freeze the air: 'Then let it wait. When I'm ready, I will bring her back with my own hands—and then make certain people pay the price.'

Above the ruins of the Imperial Capital, Chen Ji stood alone at the highest point, gazing down at this land scarred with wounds. The purple-black bloodstains glistened with an eerie glow under the sunlight, the air filled with a mingled scent of char and blood. In the distance, cultivators were anxiously cleaning the battlefield, wounded Xuanwu Guards being carried to the temporary medical camp, everything proceeding in an orderly fashion. But Chen Ji knew this was merely the brief calm before the storm. The Eye of Heavenly Dao's words still echoed in his ears; though the dimensional invasion crisis was temporarily lifted, countless rifts were still secretly expanding across the Three Realms; though the Liquidation Emissary had retreated, the Old Heavenly Dao Guardians Alliance behind him still watched with covetous eyes; and Chen Nian... his sister who had been missing for years, was now trapped in the core region of Heavenly Dao's will, awaiting his rescue.

Chen Ji lowered his head to look at the Tianji Record in his hands, the torn pages gleaming with a dim silver light under the sun. Today's battle had cost him dearly—the massive loss of Heavenly Fate Value, the damage to the Turtle Shell artifact, and the risk of being completely targeted by the Eye of Heavenly Dao. But he had also gained precious things: the preliminary manifestation of the Fourth Possibility, Su Qingyao's trust and bond with the Qingyao Sword, and... a vague yet firm direction. He knew he could no longer scheme everything alone as before. The Eye of Heavenly Dao's chess game was far vaster and more terrifying than he had imagined. And to break the game, he must find more allies, stronger power, and... the truth that has been hidden in the shadows all along.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul seemed to sense his thoughts, softly speaking in his Mental Sea: 'Master, you did well today. But this old man must remind you, the Eye of Heavenly Dao's words about 'the main course still to come' were by no means empty talk. Dimensional invasion and the Old Heavenly Dao's counterattack are only part of its plan—the true killing move... is probably still brewing. You must提升实力 as quickly as possible, otherwise when the true crisis arrives, you will have no second chance.' Chen Ji silently nodded, filing these words in his heart. He raised his head to gaze into the distance, where a faint flickering light was glimmering at the edge of the heavens—that was where Ling Yuan old Sect Leader was in seclusion, the deepest Forbidden Grounds of the Tianqing Sect. He knew it was time to uncover those long-sealed secrets.

The Liquidation Emissary's voice exploded like thunder across the Imperial Capital, carrying undeniable pressure: 'Chen Ji, you are merely a designed key—surrender the Turtle Shell or perish with the Three Realms!' The voice pierced through layers of clouds, directly entering Chen Ji's Mental Sea, causing the air around him to freeze. The cultivators of the Old Heavenly Dao Guardians Alliance shouted in unison, waves of sound echoing one after another, as if they would shatter the entire Imperial Capital. Ye Qing's Xuanwu Guard formation was already swaying, but she still死死挡在最前方, demonic path mist swirling around her, contrasting with her stubborn face. And Chen Ji simply stood quietly in place, bearing that pressure that could shatter the souls of ordinary Heavenly Fate realm cultivators, the corners of his lips even curling into a meaningful smile.
